validation.setup_note: Initial run passed 60/61. ROS live-output setup lacked the build-directory typesupport library path; adding that path and rerunning the failed check passed. The final episode-only test assertion change was rebuilt and rerun in all three modes. Runtime core hashes of v2/v3/final are identical.
new_regressions: Late spatial region gets its own confirmation window without restarting surviving hypotheses
Returning to original window origin cannot erase a late hypothesis motion baseline

limitations: One complete A/B per position, not repeated timing statistics.
The 1 m / 5 degree band only labels gross wrong-place locks; exact errors are retained.
Two positions remain unlocked and greatly exceed 14.75 CPU seconds per 29.5 seconds of input.
The corrected position retains about 0.474 m maximum error.
No hardware/RK3588, full DDS throughput, or universal scene reliability qualification.
No descriptor, registration, ambiguity, directional or free-space threshold was relaxed.
